findingSummaries: CrmController implements only 7 of the 12 routes the feature declares; sync, retry, dismiss and import-existing have no HTTP surface at all.
crm.types.ts re-exports only the three Prisma enums, but two spec files import GHL DTO types from it, so those suites cannot compile.
saveConnection and updateConfig return the raw Prisma CrmConnection row, so both endpoints respond with the encrypted token (secretCipher) to the browser.
listPipelines ignores its tenantId and calls the shared empty-credential GoHighLevelClient singleton, so GET /crm/gohighlevel/pipelines can never succeed for any tenant.
retryHandoff reads handoff.connectionId, a column that does not exist on CrmHandoff, so it always passes a null connection into handle() and throws a TypeError.
runWriteback hardcodes attempts:0 and noteWritten:false, and noteWritten is never persisted anywhere, so the R20 backoff never escalates and the GHL note is re-posted on every retry.
A write-back failure re-opens a CREATED row as WRITEBACK_PENDING, and the next poll tick re-runs the whole forward path, relabelling it LINKED and firing a second operator notification.
importExisting delegates to pollTenant, which early-returns zero counts unless the connection is already enabled — the opposite of the state a client is in when importing history.
disconnect clears only secretCipher/status/enabled, leaving tokenLast4, locationName, lastError, attentionNotifiedAt and customFieldIds from the forward paths, so the UI still claims a key is stored.
updateConfig computes first-save defaults for a row that does not exist, then unconditionally calls prisma.update, which throws P2025 as an unhandled 500.
The container reads handoffs.data, but GET /crm/gohighlevel/handoffs returns a bare array, so the Activity table is permanently empty in production.
'Save & test' never tests, and the Preview/Import, Retry and Dismiss controls are wired to nothing — four dead controls in the shipped tab.
The controller gates on the CRM_ADDON_KEY constant, but addon-gate-registry.spec's scanner only recognizes quoted literals, so P1b fails for the new crm_gohighlevel row.
testConnection on a disconnected connection flips status DISCONNECTED -> NEEDS_ATTENTION, telling the operator RouteFlow lost access when they deliberately disconnected.
saveConnection emulates upsert with update-then-catch-P2025-then-create, which races and drops connectedById on the update path.
Six spec-required routes are missing from CrmController, so R8 (sync), R22 (retry/dismiss) and R23 (import-existing) have no HTTP surface at all.
The controller gates on the CRM_ADDON_KEY constant, so addon-gate-registry.spec's P1b ("every registry key has at least one live call site") goes red for the new crm_gohighlevel row.
GET /crm/gohighlevel/pipelines calls a DI singleton GoHighLevelClient built with an empty token and empty locationId, so R3 can never succeed for any tenant.
Write-back is invoked with handoff id undefined on the normal poll path, so R20's WRITEBACK_PENDING/backoff never records and a failed write-back is silently terminal.
noteWritten is never persisted as true after a successful note, so R19(4)'s idempotency guard is inert and retries duplicate the GHL note.
The tab has no pipeline/stage picker or "Start from" input, and the Enable switch is disabled until stageId is set — so STAGE mode can never be turned on from the UI.
pollTenant discards handle()'s result, so created/linked/needsReview/dryRun/failed in the R8 counts are always zero.
The phone match compares the normalized E.164 value against raw stored columns, so R15(c) under-matches whenever a customer's phone is not already E.164.
A 429 records lastError but does not skip the tenant until Retry-After elapses, so the next 3-minute tick re-hits a rate-limited GoHighLevel account.
retryHandoff reconstructs the opportunity from a payload key that the dry-run writer never produces, so a retried lead loses its deal name, value and source.
T51 constructs `CrmHttpError` with the wrong number of arguments, diverging from the real class's contract used everywhere else in production code.
T31/T31b mock `ghlClient.listTags()` as an array of plain strings, a shape the real GoHighLevel client never returns.
matchExistingCustomer queries customers, external refs and users with no tenant predicate and without forTenant(), so a GHL lead can be linked to another tenant's customer.
@RequireAddon is called with a constant, so addon-gate-registry.spec.ts's P1b finds zero call sites for the new crm_gohighlevel row and the api test suite goes red.
GET /crm/gohighlevel/pipelines calls a shared empty-credential GoHighLevel client, so it authenticates as nobody and 500s for every tenant.
Five routes declared in the addon-gate registry and called by the web client are not implemented on the controller, so sync/retry/dismiss/import all 404.
retryHandoff reads handoff.connectionId, a column CrmHandoff does not have, then calls handle() with null and throws a TypeError after already mutating the row.
Write-back failures on a first-time handoff update CrmHandoff by id:undefined, so the failure is swallowed and the R20 backoff never schedules a retry.
A single opportunity with a missing contactId throws out of pollTenant and permanently stalls that tenant's polling.
retryHandoff and dismissHandoff address CrmHandoff rows by id alone with no tenant predicate, an IDOR the moment the declared routes are wired.
updateConfig's first-save branch is unreachable — it computes defaults for a missing row and then unconditionally calls prisma.update, which throws P2025.
CrmSyncCounts only ever reports fetched/new; created, linked, needsReview, dryRun and failed are always zero.
previewImportExisting skips the enabled/secretCipher guard pollTenant applies, so it builds a client with an empty token and throws CrmAuthError to the caller.
testConnection writes GoHighLevel's raw location country into defaultRegion, bypassing the ISO-3166 validation the DTO enforces, which can silently disable phone matching.
getStatus loads every CrmHandoff row for the tenant into memory just to compute six counts.
listPipelines() calls the shared empty-credential GoHighLevelClient singleton, so GET /crm/gohighlevel/pipelines always 401s and the connector can never be enabled.
matchExistingCustomer runs unscoped Prisma queries, so a GoHighLevel lead can be linked to another tenant's customer.
Five routes declared in the add-on registry and called by the web client do not exist on the controller.
The new crm_gohighlevel registry row has no literal @RequireAddon call site, so addon-gate-registry.spec.ts P1b goes red.
Write-back failures on a first-pass handoff are silently discarded — the row never becomes WRITEBACK_PENDING and is never retried.
noteWritten is never set to true and attempts is hardcoded to 0, so retries duplicate the GHL note and the backoff never terminates.
One failing opportunity aborts the rest of the tenant's poll tick permanently — no per-opportunity isolation.
retryHandoff reads handoff.connectionId, a column that does not exist on CrmHandoff, so every retry passes a null connection and 500s.
retryHandoff and dismissHandoff take no tenantId and act on unscoped findUnique/update by id — a cross-tenant IDOR once the routes are wired.
previewImportExisting has no time budget and issues one DB query per opportunity, and it leaks CrmAuthError as a 500 on a disconnected connection.
getStatus loads every CrmHandoff row for the tenant to compute six counts in memory, on a hot path invalidated by every mutation.
ensureTags fetches the location's entire GoHighLevel tag list on every single handoff, multiplying external API calls against the rate limit the design is trying to avoid.
The poll's budget-exhaustion path writes the opaque string "budget" into the operator-visible lastError field.
The new crm_gohighlevel registry row has zero recognized @RequireAddon call sites, so the pre-existing P1b regression test now fails.

The controller has no routes for POST /crm/gohighlevel/sync, /handoffs/:id/retry, /handoffs/:id/dismiss, /import-existing/preview, or /import-existing, even though they are required by spec R8/R22/R23
crm.types.ts does not re-export GhlContact/GhlOpportunity/GhlCustomField, which two of its own consuming spec files import from it, producing TS2305 compile errors.
ux-spec Card 2 (trigger-mode radio, pipeline/stage Selects, 'Start from' date) is entirely absent from the shipped tab, so an operator can never enable STAGE-triggered automation from the UI.
The Activity table is missing the 'When' (relative time) column required by ux-spec's table layout.
The Activity card has no loading or error state — a failed or in-flight handoffs query renders the same 'No leads yet' empty-state text as a genuinely empty log.
The 'Import existing leads' button is visually present but wired to nothing — clicking it does nothing.
The Needs-attention banner is missing the 'Test again' button ux-spec explicitly requires.
